limitations: No known radius, rotation rate, obliquity, topographic elevation, or measured coordinates.
Equirectangular grid sample area is not spherical surface area; land fraction above is only a rough map-plane fill metric.
No scientific plate model has been constructed; arcuate ridges are speculative.
Shoreline detail is draft-scale. Polar projection distortion not yet resolved.
No countries, confirmed 25 sea names, or rivers are assigned new world coordinates.
The calculated 360×180 sphere-weighted land fraction is a conditional proxy based on arbitrary candidate latitudes, not authoritative planetography.
description: Organic differentiated fracture shorelines along northeast and southeast continental complexes; two transverse non-parallel connecting rifts; several irregular, differently sized fault remnants. Planetary canon anchors remain unchanged.
